items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: Celestat had a brass band called Tuxedo Brass Band.

ctx.x: Well, Harold, a little information on the bands, different bands. What brass band do you remember when you was a boy?

Well, I remember El Celsa, the Imperial, which is one of my favorite bands, the Imperial, Emmanuel Perez. I remember Allen's band from Over the River. I remember the Tuxedo Band. Celestat had a brass band called Tuxedo Brass Band. And I also remember Professor Ch된, he always kept a brass band with the fellas that he taught. Remember the Pacific band? And I remember the Holy Ghost Brass Band. I remember the Hanna-Pacific Brass Band a couple of times. Willie Parker. Yeah, Willie Parker. Yeah. And well, you know, I…
It was probably Joe Wacken, who he was with. I don't remember what band he was with.
I was going to ask one more question about Ridgely, did they both call it the Tuxedo Band? Is there any trouble about that? Yeah.

No I never heard no confusion about it. I never heard no confusion about it because I don't think Susie had copyright on it but when Ridgely made his band he called it Ridgely's Tuxedo Band. Yeah. And Celestad Celestad's Tuxedo Band. That's right, that's the name he went on, that's the way he played. Country club or Southern Yacht Club, everywhere. Ridgely's Tuxedo Band. And people liked him very much.
Can you tell us about Burnell San Diego?

items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1979-12-07
items.q: the Imperial Brass Band, and they had and they had and Red Allen Brass Band from Across the River, the Tuxedo Brass Band with Celestan

ctx.x: And like right now it seems most of the street bands, most of the bands play, I mean you know, like, without sheet music, whereas they used to play sheet music and by number.

Yeah, well you see, the by number thing which you're talking about, you see years ago the older musicians, you know like they had some good brass bands years ago when I was a kid, like the Imperial Brass Band, and they had and they had and Red Allen Brass Band from Across the River, the Tuxedo Brass Band with Celestan, or they had some fine brass bands, and they all had music. And if they hire a man to play in a band, what they used to do, put the name of the piece of music off and use the number. Them that…
Yeah, that's one thing that I at least miss nowadays is very few bands can play dirges.
